pr_body:
The query phase applies an optimization when sorting by a numeric field.
This optimization doesn't handle early termination correctly when `timeout`
and/or `terminate_after` are used. An IAE exception is thrown at the shard
level when the timeout is reached.
This commit fixes the bug, early terminated exceptions are correctly caught
and the result is computed from the documents that the shard was able to collect
before the termination.

Closes #72661
pr_title: Fix early termination of search request with sort optimization

review_comment: Great fix! Looks like `topDocs` were never set if `TimeExceededException` or `EarlyTerminationException` was raised.

What's the reason of setting `allowPartialSearchResults` to `true` here?

I've checked and this constructor besides tests is used only in validate, explain and field capabilities actions.  I guess it is fine to return partial results here.
Because the default value is true so it should be reflected here too.
